title: Light up Chip with a greeting

steps.title: Await a command
steps.text: Chip is asleep. puts sends the text after it to the output area, like a small loudspeaker.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.text: The first puts produces the first message. Double quotes keep the words together.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.text: The next puts runs after the first. Tcl executes these commands in order.

steps.title: Hear the echo
steps.text: Each puts normally starts a new line. Compare the speech bubbles with the output.

variants.label: Mission input
variants.code:
puts "Hello, Tcl!"
puts "Ready!"

variants.label: A greeting in Chinese
variants.code:
puts "你好，芯片岛！"
puts "Ready!"

variants.label: Greet another friend
variants.code:
puts "Hello, Ada!"
puts "Ready!"

title: A name is a label; a value is what it holds

steps.title: Name the pocket
steps.text: set names a pocket and stores a value. The hero pocket holds a character name.

steps.title: Store the coins
steps.text: coins is the label. The number is the value stored inside that pocket.

steps.title: Read the pockets
steps.text: Inside double quotes, $hero and $coins read their stored values.

steps.title: Read the backpack
steps.text: Those values become part of a sentence, which puts displays.

variants.label: Mission input
variants.code:
set hero Ada
set coins 12
puts "$hero has $coins coins"

variants.label: Bo with 8 coins
variants.code:
set hero Bo
set coins 8
puts "$hero has $coins coins"

variants.label: An empty wallet
variants.code:
set hero Ada
set coins 0
puts "$hero has $coins coins"

title: One message, three different journeys

steps.title: Prepare the message
steps.text: Store a value in hero, then send a message through the three doors.

steps.title: The quote door
steps.text: Double quotes group a message and allow $hero to be replaced with its value.

steps.title: The brace door
steps.text: Braces preserve the text here. $hero is not substituted at this stage.

steps.title: The bracket door
steps.text: Square brackets run string toupper first, then give its result to puts.

variants.label: Mission input
variants.code:
set hero Ada
puts "Hello $hero"
puts {Hello $hero}
puts [string toupper $hero]

variants.label: Use the name Bo
variants.code:
set hero Bo
puts "Hello $hero"
puts {Hello $hero}
puts [string toupper $hero]

variants.label: Use the name Cy
variants.code:
set hero Cy
puts "Hello $hero"
puts {Hello $hero}
puts [string toupper $hero]

title: Multiply the ingredients, then add the bonus

steps.title: Set out ingredients
steps.text: bottles records how many bottles there are; each records their individual energy.

steps.title: Calculate the recipe
steps.text: expr multiplies the inputs. Brackets give its result to set energy.

steps.title: Add the bonus
steps.text: incr adds a bonus to the current energy value and updates that pocket.

steps.title: Finish the potion
steps.text: puts $energy reads and displays the final total.

variants.label: Mission input
variants.code:
set bottles 3
set each 7
set energy [expr {$bottles * $each}]
incr energy 4
puts $energy

variants.label: 2 × 5, plus 1
variants.code:
set bottles 2
set each 5
set energy [expr {$bottles * $each}]
incr energy 1
puts $energy

variants.label: No bottles, but a bonus
variants.code:
set bottles 0
set each 7
set energy [expr {$bottles * $each}]
incr energy 4
puts $energy

title: Connect three skills into one beam

steps.title: Connect the batteries
steps.text: The beacon needs a name, a battery count and energy per battery.

steps.title: Calculate energy
steps.text: expr calculates the total, which is stored in energy.

steps.title: Broadcast values
steps.text: In double quotes, the variable names are replaced with the real name and energy.

steps.title: Preserve a template
steps.text: The final braces preserve the literal text $energy.

variants.label: Mission input
variants.code:
set hero Ada
set cells 4
set each 5
set energy [expr {$cells * $each}]
puts "$hero ready"
puts "Energy: $energy"
puts {$energy}

variants.label: Two batteries

puts "$hero ready"

puts {$energy}

variants.label: Bo sets off

title: A condition chooses the path

steps.title: Offer the coins
steps.text: gate receives a coin count. Switch the input to see how the gatekeeper chooses.

steps.title: Check the condition
steps.text: Compare coins >= 10. Exactly 10 also satisfies “at least 10”.

steps.title: Choose a branch
steps.text: Use Enter when the condition is true and Wait otherwise. Only one branch runs.

steps.title: Receive the answer
steps.text: return passes the selected result back to the caller; puts displays it.

variants.label: Mission input
8 coins: not enough
10 coins: just enough

title: A name with a space can still be one item

steps.title: Lay out the items
steps.text: list records each item’s boundary. A multiword name must be grouped correctly.

steps.title: Pack the backpack
steps.text: An item name containing a space still occupies only one list slot.

steps.title: Count the slots
steps.text: llength counts elements rather than individual words.

steps.title: Take the second item
steps.text: lindex starts at 0, so index 1 selects the second item.

variants.label: Mission input
variants.code:
set bag [list key "red apple" map]
puts [llength $bag]
puts [lindex $bag 1]

variants.label: Use a green pear
variants.code:
set bag [list key "green pear" map]
puts [llength $bag]
puts [lindex $bag 1]

variants.label: Add a compass
variants.code:
set bag [list key "red apple" map compass]
puts [llength $bag]
puts [lindex $bag 1]

title: Let Chip collect each item in turn

steps.title: Start with an empty basket
steps.text: Set total to 0 to give the running sum a starting point.

steps.title: Collect the first item
steps.text: foreach gives the first list element to n, then runs the loop body.

steps.title: Keep collecting
steps.text: Each incr total $n adds the current value to the existing sum instead of replacing it.

steps.title: Finish the list
steps.text: When no items remain, the loop finishes and puts displays total.

variants.label: Mission input
Collect 1, 3 and 5
An empty list

title: Turn messy text into a tidy sign

steps.title: Receive the old sign
steps.text: clean receives raw text, including the spaces at its edges.

steps.title: Clean the edges
steps.text: The inner string trim removes edge whitespace. Spaces in the middle stay.

steps.title: Make it uppercase
steps.text: The outer string toupper converts the cleaned text to uppercase.

steps.title: Hang the sign
steps.text: return gives the new text back; puts displays it.

variants.label: Mission input
A different sign
Keep a middle space

title: Help every friend who needs supplies

steps.title: Read the roster
steps.text: Each row has a name and hunger value. Start with an empty selected list.

steps.title: Visit each friend
steps.text: foreach visits the records; lassign separates name and hunger.

steps.title: Deliver supplies
steps.text: Append a name only when hunger >= 5. Exactly 5 needs supplies too.

steps.title: Write the receipt
steps.text: Return the selected names as a list. Skipped friends do not appear in it.

variants.label: Mission input
Everyone has eaten
Bo just qualifies

title: One recipe, many calls

steps.title: Define the skill
steps.text: proc defines double. n is an argument waiting for a value at call time.

steps.title: Supply an input
steps.text: Calling double supplies its input for n. The next call can use another number.

steps.title: Run the card
steps.text: expr doubles n; return passes the computed result back.

steps.title: Receive the result
steps.text: puts displays the returned value. The procedure must not hard-code one answer.

variants.label: Mission input
variants.code:
proc double {n} {return [expr {$n * 2}]}
puts [double 7]

variants.label: Input 3
variants.code:
proc double {n} {return [expr {$n * 2}]}
puts [double 3]

variants.label: Decimal input 2.5
variants.code:
proc double {n} {return [expr {$n * 2}]}
puts [double 2.5]

title: Find values by their attribute names

steps.title: Create a record
steps.text: dict create stores attributes using keys such as name and hp.

steps.title: Restore health
steps.text: dict incr finds the hp key and increases its value.

steps.title: Look up by name
steps.text: dict get retrieves name and hp by key, without needing their positions.

steps.title: Show the record
steps.text: The two retrieved values form name:health, which puts displays.

variants.label: Mission input
variants.code:
set hero [dict create name Ada hp 80]
dict incr hero hp 20
puts "[dict get $hero name]:[dict get $hero hp]"

variants.label: Restore only 5 points
variants.code:
set hero [dict create name Ada hp 80]
dict incr hero hp 5
puts "[dict get $hero name]:[dict get $hero hp]"

variants.label: Use Bo’s record
variants.code:
set hero [dict create name Bo hp 60]
dict incr hero hp 20
puts "[dict get $hero name]:[dict get $hero hp]"

title: Close after writing, reopen for reading

steps.title: Open for writing
steps.text: open with w creates or overwrites a file. Its channel is stored in f.

steps.title: Write two lines
steps.text: puts $f writes to the file channel rather than the screen.

steps.title: Close and reopen
steps.text: close finishes writing. Reopen the same file with r to read it.

steps.title: Read the log
steps.text: Each gets reads one line; puts sends that line to the screen.

variants.label: Mission input
variants.code:
set f [open quest.txt w]
puts $f "Level 13"
puts $f "Saved"
close $f
set f [open quest.txt r]
puts [gets $f]
puts [gets $f]
close $f

title: A zero divisor does not have to end the trip

steps.title: Supply two numbers
steps.text: safeDivide receives a and b. Check for danger before calculating.

steps.title: Check the divisor
steps.text: When b is 0, return undefined immediately and skip the division.

steps.title: Calculate safely
steps.text: For a nonzero b, use double to perform floating-point division.

steps.title: Continue the trip
steps.text: Both calls return readable results. The zero-input branch protects this script.

variants.label: Mission input
9 divided by 2
Divide a negative number

title: Every ingredient counts

steps.title: Check the basket
steps.text: Check llength first. An empty list returns 0 immediately.

steps.title: Weigh the total
steps.text: For a nonempty list, visit every number and accumulate total.

steps.title: Share the ingredients
steps.text: Divide the floating-point total by the element count to get the mean.

steps.title: Deliver the tool
steps.text: average should work for new lists, decimal values and empty input.

variants.label: Mission input
Decimal values
An empty basket

title: Give your tool its own address

steps.title: Create a district
steps.text: namespace eval lab creates a namespace to group related tools.

steps.title: Add a tool
steps.text: Define area inside lab, with width w and height h as its arguments.

steps.title: Calculate the area
steps.text: expr multiplies width and height. This is a teaching calculation, not an EDA engine.

steps.title: Call the address
steps.text: The full name lab::area tells Tcl which namespace contains the command.

variants.label: Mission input
A 3 × 4 rectangle
Zero width

title: Capture a number from one line of text

steps.title: Open the report
steps.text: slackValue receives a whole line. Not every line will match the required format.

steps.title: Find the pattern
steps.text: regexp checks slack: followed by an optional minus sign, digits and optional decimal part.

steps.title: Read the capture
steps.text: When matched, value contains the number text. Otherwise the procedure returns NA.

steps.title: Deliver the clue
steps.text: The result is captured text, not a newly calculated timing value.

variants.label: Mission input
Positive integer slack
A line that does not match

title: A blueprint and an instance have different roles

steps.title: Draw a blueprint
steps.text: oo::class defines Chip: a class used as the blueprint for objects.

steps.title: Make an instance
steps.text: Chip new creates an object. The constructor stores its input in that object’s name.

steps.title: Call a method
steps.text: Calling label on the object retrieves its own stored name.

steps.title: Finish using it
steps.text: destroy removes the object. Separate objects can keep separate names.

variants.label: Mission input
Manufacture Wide
Manufacture Nano

title: Send the parameters through three stations

steps.title: Receive configuration
steps.text: mockFlow receives a design name and period. This lesson simulates text records only.

steps.title: Check the period
steps.text: For period <= 0, error reports failure instead of returning a normal flow.

steps.title: Connect the stations
steps.text: For a valid period, list groups the read, clock and report records.

steps.title: Output the flow
steps.text: This is a teaching checklist. No netlist is actually read and no timing is calculated.

variants.label: Mission input
Wide with period 5
A zero period

title: Follow the paths to the worst slack

steps.title: Receive the paths
steps.text: Each record has a path name and slack. Empty input returns 0 and NA.

steps.title: Inspect every path
steps.text: Only slack < 0 is a violation. Zero is allowed. Visit every path.

steps.title: Update the minimum
steps.text: Start with the first actual record and keep the smaller slack; do not start at 0.

steps.title: Close the case
steps.text: Return violations and worst in a dictionary, then read both keys to print the report.

variants.label: Mission input
All paths pass
An empty report
